Library        Version                       License   Used in                     Source
-------------  ----------------------------  --------  --------------------------  ---------------------------------------------
Jolt Physics   v5.6.0                        MIT       engine (game)               https://github.com/jrouwe/JoltPhysics
cgltf          v1.15                         MIT       engine (model loading)      https://github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf
meshoptimizer  v1.3                          MIT       engine (model loading)      https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer
Tracy          v0.14.1                       BSD-3     Profile builds only         https://github.com/wolfpld/tracy
Dear ImGui     v1.92.9b-docking (b48d1af)    MIT       editor only                 https://github.com/ocornut/imgui
ImGuizmo       18cef5e (2026-08-08)          MIT       editor only                 https://github.com/CedricGuillemet/ImGuizmo
Steamworks SDK (not included, see the docs)  Valve     engine when present         https://partner.steamgames.com/

Why each library (this file is the canonical external library table; the docs repository links here):
- Jolt Physics: deterministic build support, multithreaded, fast. Built with CROSS_PLATFORM_DETERMINISTIC and
  SSE4.2 only (AVX/FMA off) so it runs on office CPUs (Pentium, Celeron) and gives the same results everywhere.
- cgltf: single-file glTF loader.
- meshoptimizer: model optimization and LOD generation.
- Tracy: CPU/GPU profiling (only in `build.bat Profile`).
- Dear ImGui, ImGuizmo: editor UI and 3D gizmo (never linked into the shipped game exe).
- Steamworks SDK: lobbies, friend invites, relay. Valve's terms forbid redistributing it, so it is not in the
  repository; put it in third_party/steamworks/sdk and CMake picks it up.

Only the files needed to build are copied (Jolt: Jolt/ + Build/CMakeLists.txt, Tracy: public/, meshoptimizer: src/).
When adding or updating a library, change this file and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt at the repository root.
Shipped games must include THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt (the export build copies it).
